selector.rationale: Intravascular lymphoma is supported by the presence of intravascular atypical cells on skin biopsy, which aligns with the diagnosis of a lymphoma that primarily involves the blood vessels.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While there are skin manifestations, the specific finding of intravascular atypical cells points more directly to an intravascular lymphoma.

rejected.label: Pembrolizumab-induced cutaneous adverse reaction
rejected.why: The patient's previous reaction to pembrolizumab was different and had resolved, making this less likely as the cause of the current symptoms.

rejected.label: Drug-induced rash
rejected.why: The presence of intravascular atypical cells on biopsy suggests a more complex condition than a simple drug-induced rash.

rejected.label: Extramedullary hematopoietic neoplasm
rejected.why: There is no direct evidence provided in the vignette that specifically supports this diagnosis over intravascular lymphoma.

rejected.label: Intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type
rejected.why: While this is a specific type of intravascular lymphoma, the information provided does not specifically differentiate it from other forms of intravascular lymphoma based on the nasal type criteria.
